name: pl.dojomanager/demo-request
title: DojoManager – demo request
description: Request a DojoManager demo for a martial arts club, with the person's consent.

tools.name: request_demo
tools.description: Submit a request for a DojoManager demo on behalf of a specific person (owner, coach or staff of a martial arts school or club). Use ONLY after the user has explicitly agreed to share their contact details (name, email, phone) with the DojoManager team so it can contact them about a demo; set contact_consent to true only in that case. The user will receive an email (in the chosen language) and must click the link to confirm; the team contacts them only after confirmation. Returns an id for get_demo_request_status and message_for_user to pass to the user.

name.description: Full name of the person requesting the demo.

email.description: Email of the person. A confirmation link is sent here; the request is passed to the team only after the person clicks it. Disposable addresses are rejected.

phone.description: Phone number, 7–15 digits, optionally with a country code (e.g. +48 600 000 000).

school_name.description: Name of the martial arts school or club.

referred_by.description: School that recommended DojoManager, if any.

club_city.description: City where the school or club trains, e.g. "Kraków".

club_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. PL.

students_count.description: Approximate number of members (students) in the club.

message.description: What the person wants to see or ask. At most 2 links.

language.description: Language of the confirmation email and of message_for_user.

agent_name.description: Name of the assistant or app sending the request; shown to the person in the confirmation email.

contact_consent.description: Must be true: the person has explicitly agreed to share these contact details with the DojoManager team so it can contact them about a demo.

tools.name: get_demo_request_status
tools.description: Check whether the person has confirmed a demo request (pending_confirmation, confirmed, expired, rejected_spam). Returns no personal data.

tools.name: get_dojomanager_info
tools.description: Short description of DojoManager, the offer (personal demo plus 6 months of the full version free, no commitment), supported disciplines, app languages and links to the Features, Pricing, Contact and demo pages in the requested language.

language.description: Language of the description, offer and page links (pl, en, es, fr, de, uk, ru). Use the language of the conversation.
